notablePrerequisites:
Port Razer cannot be blocked by an opponent.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
easyPrerequisites: Port Razer exiled by Mardu Siegebreaker.
description:
Declare Mardu Siegebreaker as an attacker, triggering its second ability, creating a token copy of Port Razer that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with the Port Razer token, triggering its ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
